name: Cursebearing
body:
Aura moderate necromancy; CL 5th; Price +2 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

Each time this weapon deals damage, the target must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC 14) or be affected by a curse effect available to the lesser bestow curse spell. The curse inflicted does not stack with other curses with the same effect. The nature of the curse imposed by the weapon is chosen when the weapon is created and cannot be changed later.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, lesser bestow curse
